fermentables.name: Kiawe Honey
fermentables.description: White, creamy and mild with a faint tropical note.
fermentables.usageNotes: Naturally crystallises to a smooth white spread. Rare outside Hawaii.
fermentables.attribution: Sugars, moisture and pH are transcribed from "Honey Composition and Properties", White and Doner, in Beekeeping in the United States, USDA Agriculture Handbook 335 (revised 1980). Its Table 2 gives this variety's sugars from 3 samples: 36.9% dextrose, 40.41% levulose, 0.95% sucrose, 5.42% maltose and 0.35% higher sugars. Moisture and pH are its Table 1 averages over 490 floral honeys, which it does not break down by variety. ppg is 46 times the total sugars per 100 g. The previous figures on this record were not measurements at all: every honey in this catalogue had sugar and moisture summing to exactly 99.1 and a ppg of exactly 35, which is arithmetic from an assumed moisture, and the National Honey Board page they cited publishes none of it. Hawaiian kiawe is Prosopis pallida, a mesquite, and AH335's mesquite figures are the closest published analysis. They are for the genus, not for kiawe specifically.
